description: This Java class 'BookPatchDto' serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for updating or patching book details in the application. It includes various properties related to a book such as title, pages, genres, author, ISBN, publication year, and other relevant metadata. The class is annotated with Lombok's @Data for boilerplate code generation and Jackson's @JsonProperty for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: BookPatchDto
classes.description: A DTO class for patching book information in the system, encapsulating various attributes of a book that can be updated.
